name: A Lesson in Divinity
label: Quest
description: A Lesson in Divinity: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.
Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true adventurer can do.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... Well, resorting to asking adventurers for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
